ms.promise:
Context: The smart contract wallet backend is a library that contains a smart contract (on-chain), the related off-chain code, and the server code to run a smart contract-based cryptocurrency wallet for the Cardano blockchain. Any Cardano wallet (browser extension) will be able to use our library.
Task: Integrate the features into the wallet smart contract. It requires modifying the wallet smart contract (on-chain) and producing the related off-chain code.
Outputs:
・Integrate feature into the wallet smart contract: zkLogin
・Integrate feature into the wallet smart contract: multi-user transactions
・Integrate feature into the wallet smart contract: babel fees and sponsored transactions
ms.criteria:
・wallet smart contract: zkLogin feature can be found in the repo
・wallet smart contract: multi-user transactions feature can be found in the repo
・wallet smart contract: babel fees and sponsored transactions feature can be found in the repo
ms.report:
We have completed Milestone 5 of the project. The output of this milestone is the server code that implements three features: batched transactions, babel fees, and sponsored transactions.
The batched transaction code can be found here:
https://github.com/zkFold/project-catalyst-reports/blob/main/Smart%20Wallet/Batch.hs
The babel fees and sponsored transactions code can be found here:
https://github.com/zkFold/project-catalyst-reports/blob/main/Smart%20Wallet/Sponsor.hs
The smart contract code is available at
https://github.com/zkFold/zkfold-cardano/blob/main/zkfold-cardano-scripts/src/ZkFold/Cardano/UPLC/Wallet.hs
The wallet's smart contract now fully supports all three features.
